badges.name: Road builder
badges.how: Build a full road that connects a base to a main road or to spawn. Lit, walkable, no gaps.

badges.name: Bridge builder
badges.how: Build a bridge on a public route, over water, a ravine or anything else in the way.

badges.name: Shopkeeper
badges.how: Open a shop that is stocked, has its prices up and is on the Shops page.

badges.name: Game maker
badges.how: Build a mini game anyone can walk up to and play.
